card.name: The word "to" in preparation instructions
card.fires_on: The word "to" (rarely "To" or "will") right after an amount or ingredient in instructions, such as adding diluent to a vial or ranges like 2.5 mg/kg to 3.5 mg/kg.

modes.label: Recipe seasoning phrase
modes.description: "to" after an ingredient, in a cooking instruction.
modes.example: Season with salt and pepper<< to>> taste; serve.
